scripts/tah/hud.js.accumulates: Does not accumulate (at most one set leaked), but persists from first use until next `bind()`, keeping prior render-scope DOM alive via closure.
scripts/tah/hud.js.fix: In `unbind()`, add: `if (this._favDocHandlers) { document.removeEventListener('mousemove', this._favDocHandlers.move); if (this._favDocHandlers.click) document.removeEventListener('click', this._favDocHandlers.click, true); this._favDocHandlers = null; }`
scripts/tah/hud.js.risk: Verify the favorites hover/click still works after re-bind; the listeners are re-added in `_render()` so this only affects the unbound state.

scripts/tah/sound.js.issue: SFX lookup table is re-created as a new object on every non-throttled playUiSound call (hover, targeting, etc.).
scripts/tah/sound.js.fix: Hoist the SFX object to module scope as a constant, alongside TOKEN_FEEDBACK_VARIANTS and MIN_GAP.
scripts/tah/sound.js.risk: None — the object is purely static data with no closures over local state.

scripts/tah/statbar/state.js.issue: _lastValues Map keyed per token; entries may never be removed when tokens are deleted or scenes change.
scripts/tah/statbar/state.js.accumulates: One entry per token that ever appeared; survives scene changes if not cleared externally.
scripts/tah/statbar/state.js.fix: Clear _lastValues (and _fadeState, _flashingTokens, _overlayHubs) on scene teardown / canvasTearDown, if not already done in another file.
scripts/tah/statbar/state.js.risk: Cleanup may already exist in a sibling file that calls .clear() on scene change; verify before adding duplicate cleanup.

scripts/tah/statbar/state.js.issue: _fadeState Map keyed per token; same accumulation risk as _lastValues across scene changes.
scripts/tah/statbar/state.js.accumulates: One entry per token that triggered a fade; never pruned in this file.
scripts/tah/statbar/state.js.risk: Fade animations in progress could be interrupted if cleared at the wrong time; clear only on full scene tear-down.

scripts/tah/statbar/state.js.issue: _overlayHubs Map likely keyed per token; PIXI display objects stored here are never removed in this file.
scripts/tah/statbar/state.js.accumulates: One hub per token; if not pruned on token delete or scene change, both the Map entry and PIXI objects persist.
scripts/tah/statbar/state.js.fix: On scene teardown, iterate _overlayHubs, destroy each hub's PIXI children, then clear the Map.
scripts/tah/statbar/state.js.risk: Hubs may already be destroyed by their owner; double-destroy on a PIXI object is safe but verify no external code retains references.

scripts/tah/tokenStatBar.js.issue: Per-pixel color interpolation and individual drawRect calls every frame for overshield animation; osW can be 50-100+ iterations.
scripts/tah/tokenStatBar.js.fix: Replace per-pixel loop with 2-3 wider gradient bands or a single tinted sprite whose tint shifts each frame, cutting draw calls from O(osW) to O(1).
scripts/tah/tokenStatBar.js.risk: Visual fidelity of the shimmer effect will be slightly coarser; verify the animation still reads as a sweep.

scripts/tah/tokenStatBar.js.issue: _lastValues Map is set per token but never cleared on scene change; sweepLancerTokens clears _overlayHubs but not _lastValues.
scripts/tah/tokenStatBar.js.accumulates: One snapshot object (~10 fields + extras sub-object) per unique token ID across every scene visited in the session.
scripts/tah/tokenStatBar.js.fix: Add `_lastValues.clear();` inside sweepLancerTokens alongside the existing `_overlayHubs.clear()` call (around line 4019).
scripts/tah/tokenStatBar.js.risk: First actor update after scene change won't diff against a previous snapshot, so no flash fires for the initial state — matches existing first-draw behavior.

scripts/tah/tokenStatHint.js.issue: Two `new PIXI.Point` allocations every call to tokenScreenRect, which runs on every canvasPan while popup is visible.
scripts/tah/tokenStatHint.js.fix: Reuse a module-level pair of PIXI.Point objects (e.g. `const _pt1 = new PIXI.Point(); const _pt2 = new PIXI.Point();`) and call `.set(x,y)` before `toGlobal`.
scripts/tah/tokenStatHint.js.risk: Ensure toGlobal does not store a reference to the passed Point; PIXI's toGlobal returns a new Point by default so reuse of the input is safe.

scripts/tah/tokenStatHint.js.issue: 5 Hooks (hoverToken, controlToken, deleteToken, canvasTearDown, updateToken) lack a re-entry guard, unlike the guarded hooks below.
scripts/tah/tokenStatHint.js.accumulates: Each call to initTokenStatHint adds 5 duplicate hook handlers; the guarded hooks at 1401/1430 suggest re-entry was considered possible.
scripts/tah/tokenStatHint.js.fix: Add a module-level `_hookedCore` guard (like `_hookedPan`) around lines 1361-1398, or merge all hook registrations under a single guard.
scripts/tah/tokenStatHint.js.risk: If initTokenStatHint is provably called only once, the guard is harmless but unnecessary. Verify the call site.

scripts/tools/aura.js.issue: callbackCache Map grows with each unique function source string; entries are never pruned or evicted.
scripts/tools/aura.js.accumulates: One entry per distinct lambda source passed to createAura over the session; bounded by unique sources, so growth is slow.
scripts/tools/aura.js.fix: Not urgent. If desired, clear entries in deleteAuras by tracking which sources belong to which owner, or add a max-size eviction policy.
scripts/tools/aura.js.risk: Clearing a cache entry while the aura still exists would break the libWrapper intercept for that aura's macro callback.

scripts/vision/lancerDetectionModes.js.issue: When debug enabled, `_drawLosDebug` creates O(edges + viewers*targets) PIXI.Text objects every call, destroyed and re-created on each refreshToken.
scripts/vision/lancerDetectionModes.js.fix: Pool or reuse PIXI.Text objects: keep a list on `_losDebugLayer`, update text/position/style in place, hide unused ones, only create new ones when needed.
scripts/vision/lancerDetectionModes.js.risk: Must reset text content and visibility correctly; stale labels could appear if pool management is wrong.

scripts/vision/lancerDetectionModes.js.issue: `refreshToken` fires per-token per-frame during animations; each call fully redraws debug overlay, redundant with sightRefresh.
scripts/vision/lancerDetectionModes.js.fix: Debounce or batch `_drawLosDebug` with a requestAnimationFrame guard so at most one redraw per frame, e.g. `let _losDebugDirty=false; function _scheduleLosDebug(){if(!_losDebugDirty){_losDebugDirty=true;requestAnimationFrame(()=>{_losDebugDirty=false;_drawLosDebug();})}}`.
scripts/vision/lancerDetectionModes.js.risk: Debug overlay may lag one frame behind a token move; acceptable for a diagnostic tool.

scripts/vision/lancerDetectionModes.js.issue: Per-frame ticker scans `token.children` with `find()` for every placed token to locate the overlay mesh.
scripts/vision/lancerDetectionModes.js.fix: Cache the overlay mesh as `token._laSilhouetteMesh` when created; check that reference instead of `find()`.
